summary: Explains `max_fail_percentage` to abort a play once a failure threshold is exceeded, applied per batch with `serial`. The percentage must be exceeded, not equaled, e.g. use 49 to abort when 2 of 4 fail.
questions: How do I abort a rolling update if too many servers fail?
Does max_fail_percentage apply per batch or to the whole play?
Why didn't my play abort when exactly 50% of hosts failed?
What value should I use to abort when 2 of 4 hosts fail?

answer_card.title: Set a maximum failure percentage
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  max_fail_percentage: 30
  serial: 10
```
With `serial`, the percentage applies to **each batch**: if more than 3 of the 10 servers in any batch fail, the rest of the play is aborted.

The threshold must be **exceeded**, not equaled. With `serial: 4`, to abort when 2 hosts fail, set `max_fail_percentage: 49`, not 50.
